The '''Senate Subcommittee to Investigate Jedi Activity''' was a subcommittee set up within the [[Galactic Alliance Senate]] in [[44 ABY]].

After the [[New Jedi Order]] [[Plan Delta|deposed]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]], a provisional government was formed under the leadership of a [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|Triumvirate]] comprising the acting [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the Jedi Order, [[Saba Sebatyne]]. After the Jedi left Coruscant following the return of Grand Master [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], the Triumvirate was dissolved.

In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the newly-[[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence|arisen]] [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] began to infiltrate the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] government on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], placing high-level operatives in positions of power of the [[Galactic Alliance Senate]]. [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Ivaar Workan]] infiltrated the Senate by posing as a [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] named "Kameron Suldar," and in that capacity he led the Senate Subcommittee to Investigate [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Activity.

The purpose of the subcommittee was officially to investigate suspected abuses of power committed by the Jedi during their time in power under the Triumvirate. However, the true object was to descredit the Jedi and prepare the Galactic Alliance for a full seizure of power by the Sith. Workan, as head of the subcommittee, ordered the arrest of the Jedi ambassador on Coruscant, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] so as to remove her as a threat. The subcommittee's accusations combined with the descriminating news brought by the Sith's news outlet, [[BAMR News]], led to a renewel of [[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|anti-Jediism]] on Coruscant.
